title: Experimental Evaluation of Algorithm-Assisted Human Decision-Making: Application to Pretrial Public Safety Assessment
findings: The paper has no findings related to religion. Its focus is on the impact of algorithmic recommendations on judicial decisions, with fairness analyses centered on gender and race.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It evaluates the causal impact of an algorithmic recommendation system (Public Safety Assessment) on judges' pretrial decisions, focusing on fairness related to gender and race.
